title: Item added to a running custom-currency subscription without a currency is priced in the fiat invoice currency

bugs.note: The same change lets a plan be priced in a custom currency (credits) while the subscription invoices in the customer's fiat currency. An edit that adds a priced item with no currency gets the invoice currency, not the plan's, so a price of 10 meant as 10 credits is billed as 10 USD, at a different value from every other item of the subscription.
